name: @ordin/zkya-onboarding-reference
description: Executable local zkYA onboarding reference for retained zKYC authority state

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../.. run build --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../.. run build --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && node ../../scripts/clean.mjs dist && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm --prefix ../.. run build --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-core-api-reference --silent && npm --prefix ../.. run build -w @ordin/zkyc-sdk-reference --silent && vitest run
